newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices ease marginally at auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices ease marginally at auction.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices were easier at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Prices of most grades fell marginally on lower demand, forcing traders to withdraw over 39 percent of their offers. Buyers for Poland, Pakistan, Afghanistan and Russia participated in the bidding.

More than 710,892 million kg of teas were sold at the auction. The average tea price was 43.25 taka, down 0.20 from the previous sale. The next auction will be held on September 24 when 1.42 million kg of teas will be on offer. ($1.0 = 42.30)
